## Lines that already stand in a published part

- **3.198** = a line of odyssey-003, unit at line 298:
  - t: 'ἢ οὐκ ἀίεις οἷον κλέος ἔλλαβε δῖος Ὀρέστης\nπάντας ἐπ’ ἀνθρώπους, ἐπεὶ ἔκτανε πατροφονῆα,\nΑἴγισθον δολόμητιν, ὅ οἱ πατέρα κλυτὸν ἔκτα;'
  - l: "Or do you not hear what fame heavenly Orestes won\namong all men, when he killed his father's slayer,\nAegisthus of guileful counsel, who had killed his famous father?"
  - i: 'Or have you not heard what fame heavenly Orestes won among all men when he killed the slayer of his father, Aegisthus of guileful counsel, who had killed his famous father?'
- **3.200** = a line of odyssey-003, unit at line 301:
  - t: 'καὶ σύ, φίλος, μάλα γάρ σ’ ὁρόω καλόν τε μέγαν τε,\nἄλκιμος ἔσσ’, ἵνα τίς σε καὶ ὀψιγόνων ἐὺ εἴπῃ.'
  - l: 'You too, friend — for very much I see you fine and tall —\nbe valiant, so that someone even of those born later may speak well of you.'
  - i: 'You too, my friend — for I see that you are very fine and tall — be brave, so that men born long after may speak well of you.'
